title: Proofs of two $q$-congruence conjectures of Guo
summary: We prove two conjectural $q$-congruences proposed by Guo. The first is Conjecture 7.2 in Guo's work on $q$-analogues of two ``divergent'' Ramanujan-type supercongruences; it asserts a square-cyclotomic congruence for a truncated $q$-analogue of a Ramanujan-type sum when $n\equiv1\pmod4$. The second is Conjecture 4.1 in Guo's extension of Van Hamme's $(A.2)$ supercongruence; it gives divisibility modulo $[n]$ for a family of truncated basic hypergeometric sums with a parameter $s$.
